decisions.reason: The navigation and observation camera builds directly on the firm's decades of optical and star-sensor heritage, so it can interpret early mission feedback and refine the product with little effort.

The modular navigation camera line fits the strategic move toward compact, adaptable sensors and draws on core optoelectronic know-how, which makes it a natural platform for learning and adapting the design.

The space situational awareness suite extends the firm's imaging and sensor competence into a growing market, and its research network helps it absorb the new application knowledge, though the newer customer field carries somewhat more uncertainty.

The miniaturized LiDAR relates to the firm's docking and rendezvous sensor experience but is less proven and only mentioned on the website, so it stays as a development bet supported by its R&D cooperation, with a higher risk of being dropped.
